extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and developers who implement new domains/elements/mappings or extend GAP's functionality
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and API-level criteria for defining element categories, arithmetic/comparison operations, domain relations, and general mappings in the GAP system. Covers when and how to install methods, properties to maintain, and expected semantics/behavior of mapping-related operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: AdditiveInverse method dispatch rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The default method of AdditiveInverse calls AdditiveInverseMutable; methods for AdditiveInverseMutable must not delegate to AdditiveInverse; other methods to compute additive inverses need to be installed only for AdditiveInverseMutable and (for copyable objects) AdditiveInverseSameMutability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When implementing additive inverse support prefer installing methods for AdditiveInverseMutable (and AdditiveInverseSameMutability for copyable objects). Avoid mutual delegation between AdditiveInverseMutable and AdditiveInverse to prevent recursion. This is about proper method dispatch and avoiding circular delegation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order(elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Order(elm) is the multiplicative order of elm: the smallest positive integer n such that elm^n = One(elm) if such an integer exists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the order is infinite, Order may return the value infinity, but it also might run into an infinite loop trying to test the order. Implementations should be aware of possible nontermination and the possibility of returning infinity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Binary comparison operations: \= and \< semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: The underlying operations for binary comparison are \=(left-expr, right-expr) and \<(left-expr, right-expr). Comparisons via <>, <=, >, and >= are delegated to \= and \<.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In general objects in different families cannot be compared with \<; consult 4.13 for reasons and exceptions. Implement methods accordingly and be mindful of family-dispatch behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilyCompareElements property
rubrics_metrics.description: CanEasilyCompareElements indicates whether the elements in the family fam of obj can be easily compared with \=.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default method asks the family of obj; the family's default returns false. Because the ability to compare may depend on computed information, code should call CanEasilyCompareElementsFamily to get an answer without computing it. If a family knows ab initio it can compare elements, set this property as implied filter and filter for the family (3rd and 4th arguments of NewFamily).

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilyCompareElementsFamily function
rubrics_metrics.description: CanEasilyCompareElementsFamily(fam) returns false if the value of CanEasilyCompareElements is not known for the family without computing it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this family-level query to avoid expensive computations when deciding if efficient equality tests are available; ensures family-dispatch returns correct answers without triggering heavy computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanEasilySortElements and CanEasilySortElementsFamily
rubrics_metrics.description: CanEasilySortElements indicates that objects can be compared via \<; CanEasilySortElementsFamily behaves like CanEasilyCompareElementsFamily but for ordering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CanEasilySortElements implies CanEasilyCompareElements because an ordering must be total. Set as implied filter/filter for families that know they provide a natural total order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arithmetic operations available for elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Binary arithmetic operations for elements include \+(left-expr, right-expr), \*(left-expr, right-expr), \/(left-expr, right-expr), \^(left-expr, right-expr), and \mod(left-expr, right-expr).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special methods exist for \*, \/, \^ and \mod; consult their index entries for details. Implementations should adhere to documented semantics (associativity, commutativity assumptions) when providing methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftQuotient(elm1, elm2)
rubrics_metrics.description: LeftQuotient(elm1, elm2) returns elm1^(-1) * elm2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For some object types (e.g., permutations) LeftQuotient can be evaluated more efficiently than computing elm1 inverse then multiplying. Provide a specialized LeftQuotient method when the composite operation can be optimized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comm(elm1, elm2) (commutator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comm(elm1, elm2) returns the commutator defined as elm1^{-1} * elm2^{-1} * elm1 * elm2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example in manual demonstrates usage on permutations. Implementers should ensure commutator semantics follow this ordering.

rubrics_metrics.name: LieBracket(elm1, elm2)
rubrics_metrics.description: LieBracket(elm1, elm2) returns elm1 * elm2 - elm2 * elm1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: addition is assumed to be associative but not necessarily commutative; multiplication is not assumed to be commutative or associative. Implementers must respect these assumptions when providing LieBracket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sqrt(obj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sqrt returns a square root x with x · x = obj; if such x is not unique the chosen x depends on the type of obj.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Sqrt methods appropriate to object type (e.g., ER is Sqrt for rationals). Be explicit about which root is returned when multiple exist, and ensure consistency with type semantics.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseSubsetRelation(super, sub) policy
rubrics_metrics.description: UseSubsetRelation(super, sub) transfers possibly useful information from domain super to its subset sub and vice versa. It is designed to be called automatically whenever substructures of domains are constructed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Methods for this operation must be cheap and requirements should be as sharp as possible. To ensure all applicable methods are executed, all methods except the default must end with TryNextMethod(). The default method deals with InstallSubsetMaintenance information from the library.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseFactorRelation(numer, denom, factor) policy
rubrics_metrics.description: UseFactorRelation transfers possibly useful information from domain numer or its subset denom to domain factor (isomorphic to numer/denom factor) and vice versa. denom may be fail if not available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to be called automatically when factor structures are constructed; methods must be cheap and sharp. All non-default methods must call TryNextMethod(). Default handles InstallFactorMaintenance data.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseIsomorphismRelation(old, new) policy
rubrics_metrics.description: UseIsomorphismRelation(old, new) transfers possibly useful information from domain old to an isomorphic domain new.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to be called automatically whenever isomorphic structures are constructed; methods must be cheap and sharp. All non-default methods should call TryNextMethod(). Default deals with InstallIsomorphismMaintenance data.

rubrics_metrics.name: InstallSubsetMaintenance(opr, super_req, sub_req)
rubrics_metrics.description: For opr (a property/attribute), InstallSubsetMaintenance makes UseSubsetRelation(D,S) set a known value of opr for D as the value for S when D is in super_req and S is in sub_req.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical use: opr = IsFinite with appropriate filters. If opr is a property and super_req lies in opr then a false value for S can imply false for D when D lies in an appropriate filter intersection; use this to enable logical implications between super and subset.

rubrics_metrics.name: InstallFactorMaintenance(opr, numer_req, denom_req, factor_req)
rubrics_metrics.description: For opr, InstallFactorMaintenance makes UseFactorRelation(N,D,F) set a known value of opr for N as value for F when N,D,F lie in the specified filters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical use: opr = IsFinite with collection filters. If numer_req involves opr then a known false value of opr for F implies false for D provided D lies in numer_req with opr removed. Factor relations imply isomorphism relations, so explicit isomorphism maintenance need not be installed if factor maintenance exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: InstallIsomorphismMaintenance(opr, old_req, new_req)
rubrics_metrics.description: InstallIsomorphismMaintenance causes UseIsomorphismRelation(D,E) to set a known value of opr for D as the value for E when D is in old_req and E in new_req.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical use: opr = Size with old_req and new_req = IsCollection. Use to propagate attribute/property values across isomorphic domains at creation time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design principle: exploiting subset/factor/isomorphism relations
rubrics_metrics.description: When a new domain is constructed relative to other domains (subset, factor, isomorphic), it can gain knowledge by exploiting attributes maintained under those relations; UseSubsetRelation/UseFactorRelation/UseIsomorphismRelation are invoked automatically at construction time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the new domain often only sees knowledge at creation time, this is the moment to use maintenance facilities (InstallSubsetMaintenance, InstallFactorMaintenance, InstallIsomorphismMaintenance). Methods must be cheap and have sharp requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsExtAElement category
rubrics_metrics.description: IsExtAElement(obj): an external additive element that can be added via + with other elements (not necessarily in the same family).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this category for elements intended to participate in addition with elements from possibly different families.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNearAdditiveElement category
rubrics_metrics.description: IsNearAdditiveElement(obj): an object that can be added via + with elements in its family; this addition is not necessarily commutative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when addition exists within family but commutativity is not guaranteed.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAdditiveElement category
rubrics_metrics.description: IsAdditiveElement(obj): an object that can be added via + with elements in its family and this addition is commutative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when additive structure is present and commutative; informs algorithms that rely on commutativity.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNearAdditiveElementWithZero and IsAdditiveElementWithZero
rubrics_metrics.description: Near/additive element-with-zero categories indicate objects that can be added within their family and are admissible arguments for Zero(obj); near-additive need not be commutative, additive is commutative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to indicate presence of a zero element and addition; distinguishes commutative vs noncommutative addition.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNearAdditiveElementWithInverse and IsAdditiveElementWithInverse
rubrics_metrics.description: These categories indicate elements that can be added in their family and are admissible for Zero and AdditiveInverse; additive version is commutative, near-additive not necessarily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when inverse under addition is meaningful; note that being admissible as argument does not guarantee AdditiveInverse returns a value (it may fail).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsExtLElement and IsExtRElement
rubrics_metrics.description: IsExtLElement(obj): external left element that can be multiplied from the left via * with other elements (not necessarily same family). IsExtRElement: external right element multiplyable from the right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to indicate one-sided multiplicative usability across families; guides method applicability for left/right multiplication operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMultiplicativeElement and variants (WithOne, WithZero, WithInverse)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsMultiplicativeElement(obj) indicates obj can be multiplied via * with elements in its family. WithOne requires admissibility for One(obj); WithZero for MultiplicativeZeroOp; WithInverse for One and Inverse admissibility (Inverse may still return fail).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these finer-grained categories to indicate presence of multiplicative unit, zero, or inverse operations; note admissibility vs existence caveat for inverse.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMultiplicativeElementWithZero example semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Example shows forming a semigroup, adjoin zero to create a magma-with-zero and that MultiplicativeZeroOp returns zero for representative element; IsMultiplicativeElementWithZero returns true for such elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementers should provide MultiplicativeZeroOp and set category filters appropriately when a zero element is present in multiplicative structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsVector category
rubrics_metrics.description: IsVector(obj): a vector is an additive-element-with-inverse that can be multiplied from left and right with other objects (not necessarily same type).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: cyclotomics, finite field elements, row vectors. Not all lists of ring elements are vectors (e.g., lists of matrices are not) — family of list entries must imply IsAdditiveElementWithInverse for all elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNearRingElement and IsRingElement synonyms
rubrics_metrics.description: IsNearRingElement is the meet of IsNearAdditiveElementWithInverse and IsMultiplicativeElement. IsRingElement is the meet of IsAdditiveElementWithInverse and IsMultiplicativeElement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these synonyms for convenience when representing near-rings and rings at element level.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRingElementWithOne and WithInverse (and IsScalar)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsRingElementWithOne is the meet of IsAdditiveElementWithInverse and IsMultiplicativeElementWithOne. IsRingElementWithInverse and IsScalar are meets of additive and multiplicative-with-inverse categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to indicate presence of multiplicative identity or inverses in ring-like elements; set filters accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDirectProductElement category & componentwise operation semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: IsDirectProductElement is a meet of IsDenseList, IsAdditiveElementWithInverse, IsMultiplicativeElementWithInverse, and IsCopyable where arithmetic operations are defined componentwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operations on direct product elements will error if any component's operation cannot be formed. ShallowCopy returns a mutable plain list of same entries. Sum/product with lists in IsListDefault is componentwise; with non-list non-collection returns direct product element of componentwise operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: DirectProductFamily(args) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: args must be a dense list of CollectionsFamily families; DirectProductFamily returns a collections family of IsDirectProductElement objects whose i-th component is in ElementsFamily(args[i]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A collection in the returned fam may not itself be a direct product but a subcollection. Not all direct products are created via these families (e.g., DirectProduct on permutation groups returns a permutation group whose elements are not IsDirectProductElement).

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneralMappingByElements(S,R,elms)
rubrics_metrics.description: GeneralMappingByElements(S, R, elms) is the general mapping with source S, range R and underlying relation elms (collection of direct product elements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to construct general mappings by specifying explicit underlying relation elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: MappingByFunction(S,R,fun[,invfun]) behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: MappingByFunction returns a mapping mapping each s in S to fun(s). If invfun is bound the mapping is a bijection between S and R and invfun provides preimages. If five arguments with fourth false and prefun provided, prefun computes a single preimage even if map is not bijective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The mapping returned lies in filter IsNonSPGeneralMapping. Provide invfun when you can invert the mapping efficiently; provide prefun for single-preimage access when not bijective.

rubrics_metrics.name: InverseGeneralMapping(map) vs Inverse(map)
rubrics_metrics.description: InverseGeneralMapping(map) is the general mapping whose underlying relation contains (r,s) iff original contains (s,r). The inverse general mapping may be only a general mapping; if map is known bijective then its inverse general mapping will know to be a mapping and Inverse(map) works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish attributes: use InverseGeneralMapping to get relation-reversed mapping; use Inverse only when original mapping is known bijective.

rubrics_metrics.name: RestrictedInverseGeneralMapping(map)
rubrics_metrics.description: RestrictedInverseGeneralMapping(map) reverses underlying relation and restricts domain to the image of map and range to the domain of map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you need the inverse relation but limited to actual image/range rather than full range/domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: CompositionMapping semantics and property maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: CompositionMapping(map1, map2, ...) composes arbitrarily many general mappings, delegating to CompositionMapping2. It maps an element first under the last argument, then penultimate, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Properties IsInjective and IsSingleValued are maintained. If ranges of successive arguments are identical then IsTotal and IsSurjective are maintained. Do not call CompositionMapping2 directly if you need IsTotal/IsSurjective maintained. Composition may be materialized as a new mapping or stored as an iterated composition representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: CompositionMapping2(map2,map1) ordering convention
rubrics_metrics.description: CompositionMapping2 returns composition that maps an element first under map1 then under map2 (note reverse ordering of arguments relative to multiplication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be careful with argument order when composing: CompositionMapping2(map2,map1) corresponds to map2 ∘ map1 in mathematical notation; CompositionMapping delegates to this behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsCompositionMappingRep and ConstituentsCompositionMapping
rubrics_metrics.description: Mappings stored as IsCompositionMappingRep are stored as composition of two mappings; ConstituentsCompositionMapping(map) returns [map1,map2] for such representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this representation to defer materializing composed mappings and allow two-step computation of images/preimages.

rubrics_metrics.name: ZeroMapping(S,R)
rubrics_metrics.description: ZeroMapping is a total general mapping that maps each element of its source to the zero element of its range. Each mapping with empty source is a zero mapping.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to represent constant-zero mappings; ensure the range has a defined zero element.

rubrics_metrics.name: IdentityMapping(D)
rubrics_metrics.description: IdentityMapping(D) is the bijective mapping with source and range D mapping each element to itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard identity; implementers should ensure it is marked bijective and total/single-valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embedding and Projection operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Embedding(S,T) returns an embedding of domain S into T (or indexed variants). Projection(S,T)/Projection(S,i)/Projection(S) return projections of domain S onto T, an indexed component, or a natural quotient domain respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific methods for embeddings/projections are described in group product and product chapters; provide appropriate methods for data structures like direct products, semidirect products, subdirect products, wreath products, and magma rings.

rubrics_metrics.name: RestrictedMapping(map,subdom)
rubrics_metrics.description: RestrictedMapping(map, subdom) returns the restriction of map to subdom when subdom is a subdomain of the source of map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for subdomain-restricted computations; ensure subdom is validated as subset of source.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTotal property for general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: IsTotal(map) is true iff each element in the source S of map has images (smap ≠ ∅ for all s ∈ S).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to test totality of general mappings; many operations assume total mappings.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSingleValued property for general mappings
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSingleValued(map) is true iff each element in the source has at most one image (|smap| ≤ 1 for all s ∈ S); equivalently preimages of different range elements are disjoint.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When true and IsTotal true the general mapping is a mapping (see IsMapping).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMapping filter
rubrics_metrics.description: IsMapping(map) is true if map is a general mapping that assigns a unique element Image(map,elm) for each elm in its source; equivalently map is total and single-valued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use IsMapping to assert mapping semantics before calling Image/map-specific single-valued operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsInjective property
rubrics_metrics.description: IsInjective(map) is true if images of different source elements are disjoint (xmap ∩ ymap = ∅ for x ≠ y). Equivalently each element in the range has at most one preimage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect injectivity; CompositionMapping maintains this property across compositions.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSurjective property
rubrics_metrics.description: IsSurjective(map) is true if each element in the range R has preimages in the source S (i.e., {s ∈ S | x ∈ smap} ≠ ∅ for all x ∈ R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect surjectivity; maintained in compositions when ranges match appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBijective property
rubrics_metrics.description: IsBijective(map) is true iff map is injective and surjective (and mapping), equivalently a bijection between source and range.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If IsBijective holds then Inverse(map) will work and inverse will be a mapping rather than just a general mapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range, Source, UnderlyingRelation attributes
rubrics_metrics.description: Range(map) and Source(map) give the range and source of a general mapping. UnderlyingRelation(map) is the domain of pairs (s,r) with s in source, r in range and r ∈ ImagesElm(map,s); each element is a direct product element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These attributes are primary metadata for general mappings and are used by other operations like ImagesSet, ImagesElm, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: UnderlyingGeneralMapping attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: UnderlyingGeneralMapping provides access to underlying relations of general mappings (attribute name referenced but not expanded in chunk).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used internally to manage relation-level data for general mappings.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesSource attribute
rubrics_metrics.description: ImagesSource(map) is the set of images of the source of the general mapping map. It delegates to ImagesSet and is introduced only to store the image of map as an attribute value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to cache/store image of entire source when repeated access is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesRepresentative(map, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: If elm is in the source, ImagesRepresentative returns either a representative of the set of images of elm under map or fail if elm has no images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns representative only for elements in source; behavior undefined if elm not in source.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesElm(map, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: If elm is in the source, ImagesElm returns the set of all images of elm under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to get full image set for a given source element; undefined if elm not in source.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImagesSet(map, elms)
rubrics_metrics.description: If elms is a subset of the source, ImagesSet returns the set of all images of elms under map; result may be proper set or a domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result type depends on inputs; behavior undefined if elms is not a subset of source.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImageElm(map, elm)
rubrics_metrics.description: If elm is an element of the source of a total and single-valued mapping map, ImageElm returns the unique image of elm under map.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires map to be total and single-valued (i.e., a mapping). Behavior undefined if elm not in source or if map not a mapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image(map), Image(map, elm), Image(map, coll) semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Image(map) is the image of the general mapping (subset of range that are actual values). Image(map, elm) is the unique image of elm (requires map total and single-valued). Image(map, coll) is the image of subset coll of the source (map may be multi-valued); coll and result may be lists, proper sets, or domains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be careful: Image(map, elm) requires a mapping; Image(map, coll) allows multi-valued maps and when inputs/outputs are lists positions may not correspond. Use appropriate Image variant for your data type and mapping properties.
